mapper.select: SELECT ID as id, date, sp500_price as sp500Price, sp500_change_percent as sp500ChangePercent, dow_jones_price as dowJonesPrice, dow_jones_change_percent as dowJonesChangePercent, nasdaq_price as nasdaqPrice, nasdaq_change_percent as nasdaqChangePercent, russell_2000_price as russell2000Price, russell_2000_change_percent as russell2000ChangePercent FROM us_stock_indices WHERE date >= #{fromDate} ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE us_stock_indices SET sp500_price = #{snapshot.sp500Price}, sp500_change_percent = #{snapshot.sp500ChangePercent}, dow_jones_price = #{snapshot.dowJonesPrice}, dow_jones_change_percent = #{snapshot.dowJonesChangePercent}, nasdaq_price = #{snapshot.nasdaqPrice}, nasdaq_change_percent = #{snapshot.nasdaqChangePercent}, russell_2000_price = #{snapshot.russell2000Price}, russell_2000_change_percent = #{snapshot.russell2000ChangePercent} WHERE date = #{snapshot.date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO us_stock_indices ( date, sp500_price, sp500_change_percent, dow_jones_price, dow_jones_change_percent, nasdaq_price, nasdaq_change_percent, russell_2000_price, russell_2000_change_percent ) VALUES ( #{snapshot.date}, #{snapshot.sp500Price}, #{snapshot.sp500ChangePercent}, #{snapshot.dowJonesPrice}, #{snapshot.dowJonesChangePercent}, #{snapshot.nasdaqPrice}, #{snapshot.nasdaqChangePercent}, #{snapshot.russell2000Price}, #{snapshot.russell2000ChangePercent} )
